title: Questions 149-150 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
NOTICE: Staff Cafeteria Closure

To All Staff,

Please be advised that the staff cafeteria on the ground floor will be closed for emergency plumbing repairs from today until October 3. This work is needed to protect the health of everyone who uses the room.

While it is closed, staff are encouraged to use the Riverside Deli on the opposite side of the plaza. We have arranged a 30 percent discount for all employees. Simply show your staff badge at the counter. Please visit the facilities department’s Web site to see a map showing where the deli is as well as information about its opening hours.

Thank you for your patience.

Facilities Team
